name: HG1500
description: The HG1500 is Hooga's full-body red light therapy panel — a high-output device sized to cover a standing adult head to toe in a single session. It delivers 660 nm red and 850 nm near-infrared wavelengths through 300 × 5W LEDs , producing an irradiance of 115 mW/cm² at 6 inches. At 1500W with a 35.8" × 11" footprint, the HG1500 is one of Hooga's most popular full-body panels. It ships with a door mount, hanging kit with adjustable pulley , and has red / near-infrared power switches for red-only, NIR-only, or combined sessions. Who the HG1500 Is For The HG1500 is a good fit if you want full-body coverage without stepping up to the price of the PRO or ULTRA line. It gives you the same core red-light and near-infrared wavelengths as every Hooga panel, in Hooga's largest HG-series form factor. If you want higher irradiance per session or the modular PRO ecosystem, look at the PRO1500 ; for the four-wavelength quad-chip design and touchscreen controls, see the ULTRA1500 . Download the Hooga HG Series user manual (PDF) Backed by a 3-year warranty and easy 60-day returns, the HG1500 is Hooga's most-chosen full-body panel. Not sure which panel is right?
